name: ICDAR 2019 SROIE: Scanned Receipts Information Extraction & OCR
description: A benchmark dataset established for the ICDAR 2019 Robust Reading Challenge on Scanned Receipts Information Extraction and Optical Character Recognition. Organized by CVC UAB and CASIA. Contains 1,000 scanned paper receipt images featuring diverse print quality, receipt geometries, fonts, and artifacts. Evaluates three core tasks: text localization, text recognition, and key information extraction (identifying company name, date, address, and total amount).
